paragraphs: The 2023+ Sprinter standard output represents a significant change for Mercedes' commercial vehicle range — the 3.0-litre V6 diesel (OM642) was discontinued for the 2023 model year, replaced across the board by this 2.0-litre four-cylinder OM654 unit. The standard output version produces 168hp via a single-turbo configuration, sitting alongside the High Output variant which uses a twin-turbo setup for 208hp. This engine is not a development of the outgoing V6 — it's a different family entirely, with its own characteristics and rebuild requirements. The Sprinter remains in production, and we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SPRINTER (2023+, STANDARD OUTPUT) on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the SPRINTER (2023+, STANDARD OUTPUT) from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
